text_blocks.snippet: Poncho Pikachu refers to rare collectible Japanese Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG) promo cards and plush toys featuring Pikachu dressed in costumes or ponchos modeled after other Pokémon.
snippet_highlighted_words: rare collectible Japanese Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG) promo cards and plush toys featuring Pikachu dressed in costumes or ponchos modeled after other Pokémon

list.snippet: Charizard Ponchos (2014–2015): Released for Tokyo Pokémon Center openings, featuring Pikachu in Charizard X and Charizard Y ponchos.
Magikarp & Gyarados (2015): Released for the Hiroshima Pokémon Center opening.
Rayquaza & Shiny Rayquaza (2016): Released for the Tokyo Skytree Town Pokémon Center opening, with PSA 10 graded copies valued upwards of $17,000+ through platforms like PriceCharting.
Vulpix & Alolan Vulpix (2017): Released to celebrate Pokémon Sun and Moon.
Plush Variants: Stuffed toys of Poncho Pikachu (such as Victini or Mega Lucario designs) can be found via importers like Meccha-Japan ranging from $400 to $500+.
